name: Video
description: Videos beside a product's photos: YouTube, Vimeo, VK Video, Bilibili, the embed code of any site you allow, or a file of your own. The poster is kept by the shop, and the player loads only when the visitor presses play.

settings.label: Sites whose embed code is accepted
settings.help: One domain per line; its subdomains are included. YouTube, Vimeo, VK Video and Bilibili are recognised by themselves and need no line here. Embed code from any other site is refused: the right to edit products is not the right to put somebody's script on the storefront.

settings.label: Largest video file, MB
settings.help: For a file of the shop's own (mp4 or webm). It is uploaded in pieces, so the server's own upload limit does not cap it; the disk the shop's files are on does.

settings.label: Where ffmpeg is
settings.help: The ffmpeg program or the folder it is in (ffprobe beside it). Empty: "ffmpeg" as the server finds it. With ffmpeg, an uploaded file gets a poster from one of its frames, its length, and is converted in the background into a file every browser plays. Without it, the file plays as uploaded and the poster is uploaded by hand.

settings.label: Shrink uploaded videos to
settings.help: The shorter side, so a phone's tall video is measured the same way as a wide one. A bigger file is converted down to it by ffmpeg in the background; the uploaded file plays until the converted one is ready.

settings.label: Show a video mark on catalogue cards
settings.help: A small play icon beside the rating of a product that has a video.
